keywords.name: force
keywords.description: Magnitude of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: xforce
keywords.description: The x-component of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: yforce
keywords.description: The y-component of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: zforce
keywords.description: The z-component of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: Take a history of an extra variable. Use index to specify the extra index and type to specify the type.

keywords.name: id
keywords.description: Take the history of the CFD clump with this ID.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: Take the history of the CFD clump closest to this position.

examples.description: Track the fluid force on clump 1

notes: The 7.0/9.0 manuals spell the force components force-x/y/z; live, every version accepts only xforce, yforce and zforce (force-x is rejected).
Live, both the name <s> and id <i> history selectors are accepted on all versions.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): force, xforce, yforce and zforce histories created by id, position and name on all three consoles; force-x rejected on all three; the extra history accepted on 7.00 and 9.8.
